name: com.bently.somnisync
description: Server-authoritative physics networking for Unity and Somnium worlds. Includes a setup wizard, Somnium world-script exporter, compact position updates and area-of-interest filtering.

samples.description: A generated sample scene with NetworkManager, a player rig, a grabbable cube, and an NPC with wander. Import, run Tools > SomniSync > Create Quick Start Scene, save, then press Play.
